name: heat3d
signature: void heat3d(long tsteps, long n, double *A, double *B)
layout: A and B are n x n x n arrays stored with the last index fastest: element (i, j, k) is at index (i*n + j)*n + k. Both are input and output: the function updates them starting from their initial values. Only interior elements (1 <= i, j, k <= n-2) are written; the boundary elements of both arrays are fixed. A and B do not overlap. n is at least 3 and tsteps is at least 1.
